record.one_liner: Cloud data platform (data warehouse, lakehouse, AI and apps) with REST and SQL APIs and a Snowflake-managed MCP server.
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 for the SQL API; programmatic access tokens (sent as Bearer tokens) count as api_key; key-pair JWT counts as other.
record.access_notes: Trial accounts run 30 days or until the free usage balance is used up; after that the account needs an upgrade to a paid plan. Programmatic access tokens require a network policy by default.
record.api_notes: Documented REST APIs and the SQL API for executing statements; no GraphQL API seen in the fetched docs.
record.blocker_notes: Free 30-day trial gives self-serve credentials and a documented API; paid upgrade needed after trial or credits run out.
